verdict.rationale: Feitian documents an OpenSK hardware variant whose firmware users can build from the public Google OpenSK GitHub repository, so source is readable for that one product line. The evidence does not name the license, and the main Feitian FIDO keys (BioPass, MultiPass) and their tools have no published source. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated open license, open source for the mainstream Feitian key firmware and tools such as SK Manager, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Users can build firmware from the source code of Google OpenSK Github repository without changing anything, provision it to this OpenSK hardware, to experience and try FIDO authentications.
